name: EV -> Equity Bridge
description: Reconciles headline EV to the cash payable to the seller for the equity.

name: Net Debt & Debt-like Items
description: Builds the net-debt figure that flows into the EV-to-equity bridge.

name: EBITDA Normalisation Bridge (QoE)
description: Reported EBITDA adjusted to a maintainable, run-rate basis for pricing.

name: Price-Volume-Mix Analysis
description: Decomposes the revenue variance between two periods into price, volume, mix and interaction effects, by product.

name: Price-Volume-Mix Analysis (3-Year Trend)
description: Decomposes the revenue variance across three consecutive periods into price, volume, mix and interaction effects, by product, with a chained 3-period revenue bridge.
